refnamediv.refpurpose: Type providing an interface for an in-language function

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The SilikoFunction type encapsulates an in-language function for the Siliko language. Functions requiring a state object can be built using a SilikoFunctionVTable with SilikoFunctionCreate or a wrapper for a pure function can be created with SilikoPureFunctionCreate.
